nextProject.title: Pocketpills

children.text: Canada’s largest online pharmacy needed a digital presence that could scale with its next big move: integrating telehealth alongside its pharmacy platform. Already trusted by thousands of Canadians each month, the goal was to create a unified, credible, and intuitive experience that made managing prescriptions and virtual care effortless.

(app UX) we delivered a brand refresh, website redesign, and motion design system. The direction was anchored in trust, convenience, and innovation, balancing the rigor of healthcare with the clarity and ease of a modern tech platform. We collaborated closely with their in-house development team to bring the design to life, optimizing for both customer confidence and conversion. The result is a scalable design system and digital experience that positions Pocketpills as more than a pharmacy, elevating it into a comprehensive healthcare platform built for the future.

work.thumbnailExcerpt: Matchday motion design for Malaysia’s most decorated club.
work.title: Johor Darul Ta’zim

children.text: Johor Darul Ta’zim is Malaysia’s most decorated football club, and matchday at the Sultan Ibrahim Stadium is a show in its own right. We created the club’s event-day motion visuals — high-energy LED graphics that run across the stadium surfaces and social channels, from pre-match build-up to the final whistle.

Modular motion scenes form the backbone of the system, each built with safe zones that keep the club crest and partner marks readable at any scale — from massive LED ribbons to a phone screen. Aggressive, high-energy movement drives the stadium atmosphere, while venue-ready loop packages run cleanly through pre-match and halftime with no visible jumps. The same scenes cut down into social clips, giving the media team fast deployment on match day without losing the premium feel.
